amendment: Owner-directed scope: unrelaxed trope gate, then exactly nine top-1 relaxations; no tail/cal before a positive trope screen.

population.primary_screen: all 9 runkit trope parents, seed 11, same local host and RTX 2060 SUPER
population.relaxation: No xTB relaxation during the screen. After the gate, relax only the nine seed-11 top-1 rows from the best qualifying arm.
population.paired_control: control, adam_metric, and fire_metric runs on the same machine
panels_excluded: cal until a positive trope screen

gate_metrics: paired median top-1 solver score change
paired top-1 delta E_unrel change (MACE, kJ/mol)
global obscene rate across all generated rows (delta E_unrel > 200 kJ/mol)
worst parent top-1 delta E_unrel and its parent code
floor delta E_unrel across generated rows

cost.metric: wall time per solver run against same-run control

failure_policy: Report failed evaluations as failed; never substitute zero. A failed gate remains failed.
